title: step-n-substitution-recurrence
description: A structural-depth parameter n >= 2 that emerges within aperiodic settling: a single renormalization-style scale controlling the substitution's recurrence depth, alphabet size, cohomological rank, growth-rate algebraic degree, and bilattice alignment, which all co-increment together.

n.description: the step-depth parameter n >= 2; not an arbitrary cardinality but a structural depth of the substitution settling

recurrenceDepth.description: how far back the closure rule's antecedent depends; a step-n rule gives an n-term recurrence (a_k = a_{k-1} + ... with n prior-term dependencies); equals n

alphabetSize.description: number of letters in the substitution alphabet; one row/column of the substitution matrix per letter; equals n

cohomologicalRank.description: rank of the post-shift-quotient Anderson-Putnam classifying invariant of the step-n substitution; equals n

growthRateDegree.description: minimal-polynomial degree of the growth rate, a degree-n (Pisot-type) algebraic number from the characteristic polynomial of the substitution matrix; equals n

coIncrementing.description: a +1 shift in any one structural level propagates to a +1 in all others; recurrence depth, alphabet size, cohomological rank, and growth-rate degree are all exactly n and increment together as n varies
